turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog won't sit still for a single photo. It's all blur.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Dogs are tough models. Do you want to try outdoors at the park where the light is bright, or indoors by a window with treats in your hand?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a second, my roommate wants to ask me something. I'll let you know when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, would you ever swap rooms with me? The buses outside mine start at five.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Mine's next to the boiler though. It clunks all night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Clunking I can handle. Brakes squealing at five I can't.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Hmm. If you give me your big wardrobe, maybe.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Seriously? Done. Can we move stuff this weekend?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sunday. After I've had a lie-in, obviously.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, did you call the landlord?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not yet, I'll do it tonight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. The dog that won't sit still. Park or window light?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Inside. At the park he just sniffs everything.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair. Hold the treat right above the lens and he'll look straight at you.
